opportunities.evidence_scope: Gemma 4 31B IT exact campaign c32 workload; prior SGLang assistant measurement plus current upstream vLLM/Speculators support
competing_explanations: assistant acceptance is the limiter and can improve with on-policy fine-tuning
assistant and target-verification runtime overhead dominates, so higher acceptance will not materially improve the endpoint
the prior SGLang integration, rather than assistant quality, caused most of the weak endpoint gain
opportunities.mechanism: fine-tune the confirmed Gemma 4 EAGLE-3 warm start on target-generated campaign-like responses through Speculators' supported online CLI; retain the unchanged official assistant as the stock MTP control
opportunities.modifiable_fraction: unknown until current-vLLM stock-assistant CUDA attribution

opportunities.falsifier: a disjoint holdout shows no improvement in accepted target tokens per combined draft-plus-verify CUDA second after one bounded pilot
